decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant-management line with visible ongoing website presence, so dropping it would write off development investment and undercut the announced direction toward integrated process-media systems.

The cleaning centrifuge is a capital-intensive engineered product central to the firm's filtration and sustainability narrative, and the firm has publicly committed to it, so persistence is likely even if early sales are modest.

Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's established conveying business with sunk tooling and sales investment, and any weak results can be attributed to the temporary machine-tool demand slump.

Hinged belt chip conveyors sit at the heart of the firm's core metalworking offering and remain publicly featured, so management would justify its investment by keeping the product rather than exposing the launch as a mistake.
